nodes.title: Dududa Runtime And Operator Client
nodes.purpose: Deliver the deterministic Agent runtime and a real NapCat-backed multi-account QQ operator client.

nodes.title: Model Selection Epic
nodes.purpose: Own the shared architecture for task complexity, tier policy, and static endpoint routing.

nodes.title: S08 Selection Contracts
nodes.purpose: Freeze versioned tier, complexity projection, endpoint, traffic, and decision contracts.

nodes.title: S08 Static Router
nodes.purpose: Implement deterministic filtering, admission, reliability, registry, Fake, and one compatible Adapter.

nodes.title: S09 Perception And Tiering
nodes.purpose: Implement validated perception, complexity assessment, deterministic tier policy, social decision, and Eval.

nodes.title: S10 Offline Runtime
nodes.purpose: Build the explicit-mention direct-chat vertical loop and prove shadow has no side effects.

nodes.title: S11 Controlled Rollout
nodes.purpose: Add typed rollout modes, persistent idempotency, canary ownership, kill switch, metrics, and rollback.

nodes.title: S08-S11 Completion Audit
nodes.purpose: Prove every accepted requirement with cross-stage verification and record external evidence gaps.

nodes.title: Mew And NapCat Web Parity
nodes.purpose: Reproduce the Mew QQ-client surface over Dududa's real multi-account NapCat backend.

nodes.title: NapCat Web Foundation
nodes.purpose: Establish account-scoped rich-message, capability, cursor-history and persistence contracts.

nodes.title: Mew Chat Parity
nodes.purpose: Port Mew chat rendering, composition, history, search, drafts and message actions to NapCat.

nodes.title: Mew Directory And Group Parity
nodes.purpose: Port contacts, notifications, group management, resources and settings with capability gating.

nodes.title: Mew Parity Audit
nodes.purpose: Prove real NapCat multi-account behavior, security and desktop/mobile Mew parity.

nodes.title: Offline Agent Expansion
nodes.purpose: Complete the governed S12-S22 and bounded S20 engineering chain before any real-group validation.

nodes.title: S12 Entry Gate Production Shape
nodes.purpose: Make the existing runtime safely composable, default-off and reproducible without enabling a real Endpoint.

nodes.title: S09 Additive Semantic Contract
nodes.purpose: Add span, entity, reference and explicit uncertainty contracts with a synthetic Schema pilot.

nodes.title: S12A MCP V2 Spike
nodes.purpose: Decide MCP v2 adoption using iCourse compatibility and isolated Fake lifecycle evidence.

nodes.title: S12 Unified MCP
nodes.purpose: Implement one Core-owned multi-Server Client and Registry with iCourse as the sole real compatibility Adapter.

nodes.title: S13 Bounded Capability Runtime
nodes.purpose: Map explicitly authorized business Capabilities to governed Provider calls and bounded Observations.

nodes.title: S14 Memory Lifecycle And Retrieval
nodes.purpose: Complete Memory administration, deletion and lexical retrieval without weakening Scope authority.

nodes.title: S15 Response Profile And Persona
nodes.purpose: Add deterministic short, medium and long Response Plans with fact-preserving composition and rendering.

nodes.title: S15A-S15E Controlled Proactive Outbound
nodes.purpose: Build the default-off initiated-run, scheduling, source and no-send Shadow sequence.

nodes.title: S15A Proactive Contracts
nodes.purpose: Freeze target-bound initiation, authorization, preview, dispatch and reconciliation contracts.

nodes.title: S15B Durable Scheduler
nodes.purpose: Materialize time-zone-aware occurrences and durable single-owner claims under an injected clock.

nodes.title: S15C Governed Source Contracts
nodes.purpose: Define source-neutral contracts and prove them with fixed fixtures rather than fictitious live MCP Servers.

nodes.title: S15D Digest Shadow
nodes.purpose: Compose fixture-backed scheduled digests in a recommendation-only runtime with no delivery capability.

nodes.title: S15E Probe Shadow
nodes.purpose: Detect bounded group-level opportunities and prove the no-send proactive policy against synthetic conversations.

nodes.title: S16 Operations Hardening
nodes.purpose: Prove health, backup, restore, upgrade and rollback from a versioned release manifest.

nodes.title: S17 Layout Migration
nodes.purpose: Move repository surfaces incrementally while preserving compatibility and a recoverable previous release.

nodes.title: S18 Evaluation And CI
nodes.purpose: Unify versioned fixtures, traces, fault injection and reproducible repository verification.

nodes.title: Repair GitHub CI Run 33897997167
nodes.purpose: Reproduce actual Python and offline-evaluation failures and restore passing CI without weakening checks.

nodes.title: S19 Local Integration Audit
nodes.purpose: Prove the complete release-required offline chain and freeze its rollback evidence without real traffic.

nodes.title: S22 Evidence-Based Legacy Cleanup
nodes.purpose: Remove only compatibility surfaces whose consumers have migrated and whose previous release remains independently recoverable.

nodes.title: S20 Offline Bandit Foundation
nodes.purpose: Add replayable same-role and same-tier decision, support and estimator contracts without training or exploration.

nodes.title: S21 Bot Control Plane
nodes.purpose: Establish governed group-service initialization and operator control before any real-group validation.

nodes.title: S21A Control Plane Foundation
nodes.purpose: Define the framework-neutral profile, assignment, operator command and projection foundation over Fake group and service facts.

nodes.title: S21B Group Onboarding
nodes.purpose: Let an authorized administrator preview and activate one initial group service profile with immutable Runtime assignment and recovery.

nodes.title: S21C Governed Operations
nodes.purpose: Expose authoritative operational projections and only the existing typed Core mutations through the Control Plane.

nodes.title: S21 Completion Audit
nodes.purpose: Prove isolation, recovery and governed Agent operations while removing browser-local authority and direct-NapCat Agent delivery.

nodes.title: PR10 Selective Plugin And MCP Integration
nodes.purpose: Extract only non-duplicate PR10 capabilities into canonical, default-off plugin and Unified MCP boundaries while preserving the existing Core and deployment composition.

nodes.title: Three-Tier LLM API Key Pools
nodes.purpose: Add an independent Web credential workbench and server-side SecretRef-backed pools for the three Dududa reasoning tiers without changing tier policy, Runtime authority or existing Provider contracts.

nodes.title: Bot Runtime Repair And Stable Release
nodes.purpose: Repair the production control-plane connection and credential workflow, converge only Bot services on verified stable releases, and retain private rollback artifacts while publishing sanitized implementation evidence.

nodes.title: Group Context And Honest Preview Results
nodes.purpose: Connect bounded same-group history and explicit preview outcomes, correcting demonstrated perception conflicts without weakening safety.

nodes.title: One-Click External Model Configuration Apply
nodes.purpose: Apply saved external provider pools through the authenticated host boundary and show truthful applied state without browser credentials or Docker access.

nodes.title: Current Arc Compatibility Release
nodes.purpose: Replace the deployed untracked legacy Arc implementation with a verified current compatibility implementation without silently losing existing commands.

nodes.title: PR12 And Per-Group Plugin Controls
nodes.purpose: Merge Emoji Kitchen, connect group-level plugin switches to real execution, and deploy current Bot-only artifacts while retiring superseded running versions.

nodes.title: Fixed Demo And Runtime Validation
nodes.purpose: Define a five-to-ten-minute full-product demonstration, run fixed known questions through the current no-send Runtime, repair reproduced defects, and publish an evidence-backed report.

nodes.title: S23 Authorized Real-Group Validation
nodes.purpose: Run separately authorized inbound, digest and probe canaries only after every release-required local gate is complete.
